name: ScoreStory
summary: Combines customer-satisfaction scores with AI follow-up conversations, with a free trial and Essential, Plus and Pro plans in euros.
description: ScoreStory combines CSAT/NPS-style scores with AI conversations to explain why a score was given. Official pricing (excluding VAT): Free is 10 participants, no credit card, and you can cancel at no cost if you have not yet had 10 participants. Essential is €50/month or €500/year (10 participants/month, 120/year, €3.50 per extra participant). Plus is €125/month or €1,250/year (50/month, 600/year, €3.00 extra). Pro is €475/month or €4,750/year (250/month, 3,000/year, €2.40 extra). An annual contract is pay for 10 months and get 12. Struck-through list yearly figures (€600 / €1,500 / €5,700) also appear next to the current prices. Unlimited users are included; SSO is extra; Enterprise is on request.
